name: AUTH_SERVICE_URL
summary: Kernel auth service base URL, including the /auth prefix. Read by @ima-jin/auth for session and app-token verification and by the attestation client.

name: MEDIA_SERVICE_URL
summary: Kernel media service base URL, including the /media prefix. Survey definitions are signed documents (media assets) stored here.

name: IMAJIN_KERNEL_URL
summary: Kernel base URL (no path). Used by loadAppSigningKey() to redeem the claim code and to fetch this app's signing key at boot.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAJIN_AUTH_URL
summary: Kernel origin (no path) the "Sign in with Imajin" link points at (`<value>/auth`). Baked into the client bundle at BUILD time; rebuild after changing.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
summary: This app's public URL. Its HOST is the `aud` used to verify scoped app tokens — it must match a host in this app's registered tokenAudiences (operator-confirmed at registration, docs/REGISTRATION.md).

name: IMAJIN_APP_DID
summary: This app's own did:imajin:… from registration (docs/REGISTRATION.md); dev and prod each have their own. Required on every boot once a keystore exists. Not a secret.

name: IMAJIN_ENV
summary: Selects the kernel session cookie name in @ima-jin/config: `dev` → imajin_session_dev, anything else → imajin_session. MUST be `dev` on the dev instance (a production build is NODE_ENV=production, which does not imply dev); leave unset on prod.

name: IMAJIN_APP_KEYSTORE
summary: Path of this app's 0600 bootstrap keystore (never the vault key itself). Default ./.imajin/keystore.json relative to the process cwd. Set it to an absolute path outside the checkout so it persists across deploys, and keep it separate for dev and prod.

name: IMAJIN_APP_CLAIM_CODE
summary: Advanced/CI fallback. The normal operator path is pasting the one-time code from the kernel operator's /jin approval card on `<app>/claim` (imajin-ai#2427) — no env var needed. If set, it is spent on first boot (no keystore yet) or a lost-keystore rebind; delete it afterwards.

name: DYKIL_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
summary: Removed. The app throws at boot if this is set — the signing key comes from loadAppSigningKey(), never from env.

name: DYKIL_RESPONSE_ATTESTATION_TYPE
summary: Attestation type a respondent-signed response is issued under (default `dykil/survey-response`). Must already be registered with the kernel (docs/REGISTRATION.md §5).

name: DYKIL_LEGACY_IMPORT_ATTESTATION_TYPE
summary: Attestation type for NODE-WITNESSED legacy-import rows (default `dykil/survey-response-legacy-import`). Used by scripts/import-legacy.ts and when reading imported responses.

name: EVENTS_SERVICE_URL
summary: Events service base URL (`<kernel>/events`). Only ticket-gated surveys need it; they answer 501 until it is set.

name: DYKIL_EVENTS_AUTHORIZATION_ID
summary: Id of the `app.authorized` attestation granting this app `events:read`; the ticket gate mints its token against it. Operator-created per environment; ticket-gated surveys answer 501 until set.

name: LEGACY_DATABASE_URL
summary: Connection string for the OLD dykil.* Postgres schema, via a READ-ONLY role. Read only by scripts/legacy-baseline.mjs (deploy step 6) and scripts/import-legacy.ts — never at request time. Unset it once the legacy data is retired.

name: PORT
summary: Listen port. Set by the pm2 ecosystem entry (prod 7101, dev 3101); only used directly by `pnpm dev`.

name: NODE_ENV
summary: Set to `production` by the pm2 entry and by `next build`/`next start`. Do not set it in the env file.

name: NEXT_RUNTIME
summary: Injected by Next.js; instrumentation.ts only bootstraps the signing key when it is `nodejs`. Never set by hand.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH
summary: Reverse-proxy path prefix (`/dykil`). Set by next.config.mjs at build time — not an env-file value. The Caddy route forwards the prefix intact.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_PREFIX
summary: Read by @ima-jin/config to derive service URLs. dykil takes every service URL from its own env vars; leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DOMAIN
summary: Companion to NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVICE_PREFIX (default imajin.ai). Leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_NOTIFY_URL
summary: Read by the shared @ima-jin/ui NavBar for its notification bell. dykil has no notifications of its own; leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VERSION
summary: Read by @ima-jin/ui's build-info footer line. Optional cosmetic build stamp; leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_HASH
summary: Companion to NEXT_PUBLIC_VERSION: commit hash shown in the @ima-jin/ui build-info line. Leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_COMMIT_COUNT
summary: Companion to NEXT_PUBLIC_VERSION: commit count shown in the @ima-jin/ui build-info line. Leave unset.

name: LOG_LEVEL
summary: pino log level for @ima-jin/logger (default info). Output is stdout only; pm2 captures it.

name: ENABLE_REQUEST_LOG
summary: Logger request-log switch. Leave unset: this app wires no log sink (AGENTS.md — stdout only).

name: ENABLE_APP_LOG
summary: Logger persisted-log switch. Leave unset: this app never persists logs to a database.

name: LOG_DB_TRANSPORT
summary: Logger DB-transport switch. Leave unset: logging must never touch a data store (AGENTS.md).

name: APP_LOG_LEVEL
summary: Minimum level the logger would persist (default warn). Inert while persistence is off.

name: ATTESTATION_INTERNAL_API_KEY
summary: @ima-jin/auth act-as / attestation calls. dykil exercises neither; leave unset. Never hand-mint it.

name: AUTH_INTERNAL_API_KEY
summary: Deprecated @ima-jin/auth internal key (agent delegation). Not used by dykil; leave unset.

name: PROFILE_SERVICE_URL
summary: @ima-jin/auth credential resolution. Not used by dykil; leave unset.

name: PROFILE_INTERNAL_API_KEY
summary: @ima-jin/auth credential resolution key. Not used by dykil; leave unset.

name: NODE_DID
summary: @ima-jin/auth node-act-as check (kernel node DID). Not used by dykil; leave unset.

name: APP_URL
summary: @ima-jin/auth fallback origin for redirects. dykil does not rely on it; leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
summary: @ima-jin/auth fallback origin for redirects (after APP_URL). dykil does not rely on it; leave unset.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAJIN_APP_ID
summary: Listed in the app template (registry `app_…` id); no code in this repo reads it. Safe to omit.

name: SESSION_COOKIE_SCOPE
summary: Listed in the app template; no code in this repo reads it. Safe to omit.

name: IMAJIN_APP_AUD
summary: Override for the `aud` scoped app tokens are verified against (read by @ima-jin/auth). Defaults to this app's registry slug (`dykil`), which apps.provision writes into tokenAudiences. Never a host: path-routed apps share one (imajin-ai#2706). Leave unset.

name: REGISTRY_SERVICE_URL
summary: @ima-jin/config registry service URL resolution. Not used by dykil; leave unset.

name: REGISTRY_URL
summary: Deprecated alias of REGISTRY_SERVICE_URL read by @ima-jin/config. Not used by dykil; leave unset.
